checkpoints.description: [1/4] Plan: cold-start persistent-layout recovery cycle

impact_assessment.why: Persistent MemoryStore is written every step but never read by Planner; a restart with hidden goal fields truncates (200 steps, 0 reward).
impact_assessment.benefits: Recovery behavior from persistent substrate; planner probe trace shows state/memory/persistent source; ablation kills both.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: Planner gains an optional recall source and probe field; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: none (single-thread); state: separate layouts table preserves memories count and standing traces.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Separate layouts table with INSERT OR IGNORE; source optional; cache episode-scoped; all standing pins and goldens re-run; failing-first test.

[1/4] Plan: reject incomplete layout writes and heal poisoned layouts

impact_assessment.why: A cold-first run with no prior warm layout writes a stripped state; first-write-wins then keeps it, so a later full run cannot restore recovery.
impact_assessment.benefits: Cold-first then warm then cold recovers; existing incomplete layouts heal; trace shows layout completeness and persistent source.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: save_layout gains optional replace; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: none; state: layouts table unchanged, content replacement only when current is complete and existing is incomplete.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Completeness gate before any write; replace only complete-over-incomplete; executable negative control patches the gate; all cycle 45 pins re-run.

[1/4] Plan: bounded trust for legal backend proposals using unrewarded-step stall

impact_assessment.why: Planner returns any legal backend proposal forever; a stalled legal proposal truncates at 200/0, and the self-model outcome signal is not load-bearing.
impact_assessment.benefits: Bad legal proposals fall back to the rule after a 20-step stall; good backends and rule-only runs unchanged; trace records proposed/rule/accepted/fallback.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: Planner gains trust_window and a model_decision probe; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: none; state: hub gains steps_since_reward, vectors unchanged.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Extract rule action before decision; default window 20; disable via trust_window=None for raw floor control; all goldens and standing pins re-run; failing-first tests.

[1/4] Plan: distinguish genuine completion from step-cap exhaustion in run verdicts

impact_assessment.why: run_task_logged writes verdict done whenever the world sets done, but the world also sets done at the 200-step/energy cap, so failed runs are logged as successes.
impact_assessment.benefits: Verdict records state the fact: done only before the cap; truncated at the cap; reason carries steps and reward.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: verdict/reason text changes for capped runs only; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: none; state: hash chain unchanged, record count unchanged.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Extract verdict helper, pin success and cap cases, patch-helper ablation restores legacy label, all standing pins re-run.
